action.description: Choose apply, create, update, delete, draft.

apply.description: When true, persist registry mutations. Defaults to dry-run.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence to apply; lower candidates are queued.

reportPath.description: Filesystem path to a reconciliation_report.json artifact.

apply.description: When true, write changes to disk.

items.description: A single-create payload without action or apply; the handler checks every value against MappingEntry and returns OODS-V219 per-entry outcomes for invalid entries.

mappings.description: Create entries, each without apply. All entries are checked before one atomic write.

mappingsPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON document { mappings: [...] }, using the same entry shape.

updates.description: Fields to change: oodsTraits, confidence, propMappings, metadata, substitution. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

DisambiguationDecision.description: Draft v1.4.0-gated review-decision payload. OODS accepts the shape but current component_map action=apply handlers ignore it.

disambiguation_decisions.description: Review decisions to append; does not gate creation.

component.description: The shipped OODS Foundry component id being replaced.

localPath.description: Absolute built package directory used by preview; omitted from consumer source imports.

version.description: Exact team package version; code generation needs this or an installed package manifest.

passthrough.description: Unlisted OODS Foundry props keep their names. False drops unlisted optional props; required props must be translated.

props.description: OODS Foundry prop to team prop, with optional scalar value map; values not in the map are preserved. Children, slots and event bindings keep their framework conventions.

project.description: Absolute shadcn project directory containing components.json and installed Tailwind 4 with Vite or PostCSS. React supports Radix and Base UI; Vue supports shadcn-vue on Reka. React Aria and unknown styles are refused.

module.description: Project import beginning with a components.json alias and resolved by TypeScript paths.
